title.narrative: Strengthening the capacity of Catholic Sisters in ACWECA for deeper evangelization and advocacy

description.narrative:
This project seeks to strengthen the leadership and institutional capacity of ACWECA. Specifically, this project seeks to achieve the following: 1. To train regional safeguarding focal points in safeguarding and support these to roll-out plans to enhance safeguarding, including setting up complaints and feedback mechanisms for the National Conferences of Women Religious. 2. Train a team of regional Justice, Peace, and Integrity of Creation (JPIC) champions in peacebuilding, conflict resolution, climate change and human rights advocacy and spearhead a regional formation of the sisters on JPIC. 3. Develop and review existing polices and systems in place in order to strengthen the governance and operational performance of the ACWECA.
By reviewing and developing policies, training safeguarding contacts and strengthening governance structures, ACWECA aims to empower Sisters for impactful, professional and ethically sound contributions in their diverse roles across the ten countries, fostering a stronger, safer, and more impactful regional association.
